game: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance / Rebirth

kb_left_control.action: hold to drop held pill, card, rune or trinket

right_trigger.action: hold to drop held pill, card, rune or trinket

disputed.A: One source (thebindingofisaacrebirth.wiki) claimed A=shoot on Xbox by default, but the same page contradicted itself elsewhere by saying shooting is done with the right stick and bumpers/triggers handle bombs/items; could not confirm any default face-button binding.
disputed.B: Same page claimed B=use active item on Xbox, conflicting with its own and other sources' statement that LT is the active-item button by default; unverified.
disputed.X: Claimed as 'drop card' on Xbox by the same inconsistent source; conflicts with RB/RT-based pocket-item scheme reported elsewhere.
disputed.Y: Claimed as 'drop trinket' on Xbox by the same inconsistent source; conflicts with the right-trigger-hold drop scheme reported elsewhere.
disputed.kb_f: Reported by some guides as a default 'toggle fullscreen' key, but this is an app/window setting rather than a gameplay control and wasn't confirmed on every source, so left out of the main list.
disputed.right_trigger: Some summaries described RT as 'swap consumable/active item' rather than purely 'drop/hold to drop'; exact wording of the action differs between guides.

source.note: Primary source for the full keyboard and Xbox bumper/trigger/stick layout, cross-checked against https://bindingofisaac.wiki.fextralife.com/Controls and search summaries citing the same LB/LT/RB/RT scheme. Could not find a page giving an authoritative, self-consistent listing of default Xbox face-button (A/B/X/Y) bindings — thebindingofisaacrebirth.wiki/systems/controls/ gave self-contradictory answers across two separate fetches of the same URL, so its face-button claims were excluded from controls and moved to disputed.
